limitations: This gate proves readiness and installed version/build only. It does not establish WatchConnectivity counterpart registration, real transport, application workflows, timer accounting, actual WidgetKit/App Intent/Live Activity delivery, accessibility, energy, long-duration behavior or physical failure-recovery acceptance.

The coordinator operated the Xcode installations and launches; this verifier performed only the authorized read-only preflight and local artifact inspection. The preflight does not by itself prove the installation sequence or preservation of prior application data.

The device queries do not cryptographically hash installed binaries or inspect installed extension contents. Source/product binding uses clean provenance, the coordinator deployment record and unchanged local development-product hashes.
The reviewed icon PNGs demonstrate supplied default masking only. They are not Home Screen screenshots or evidence of light/dark/Auto/tinted appearance selection on either device.
Debug development signing and behavior are distinct from the independently inspected Release archive and App Store distribution IPA; no equivalence or public-release approval is claimed.

No install, launch, build, test, source repair, app-data read/write, erase, uninstall, unpair, simulator operation or App Store action was performed by this verifier. Earlier failed/pre-sequencing observations remain preserved.
